Your wallet has a season too, and November is the saving one.

Here is how we read a month. Every month has an element, which we call the Sky, and an animal, which we call the Season. From Sat 7 Nov, 5:52 PM, November's Sky is Yin Earth: soft, patient soil. Its Season is the Pig, a Water animal: deep, quiet water under the surface. Water is the old symbol for money and flow, and soil holds water, so the month leans towards saving and planning, not splashing. Handy, with 11.11 and bonus season here. 🌱

The good: budgets, year-end reviews and 2027 plans land well. Small, steady care beats grand gestures. Rest is on the plan.

The catch: soft soil worries. Frost hides growth, it does not stop it, so slow results are the season doing its job.

You have an element too, set by the day you were born. Wood people get a money month, Fire people a self-expression month, Earth people a people month, Metal people a learning month, Water people a responsibility month. Find yours free at the link in bio.

So which is it this November: the 11.11 cart or the 2027 plan? Tell us in the comments.
